description.text: The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam marked its fiftieth anniversary with a collaboration with The Pokémon Company International. From 28 September 2023 to 7 January 2024 it showed six paintings in which Pokémon card illustrators Naoyo Kimura, sowsow and Tomokazu Komiya put Pokémon into six of its Van Goghs, with a Pokémon Adventure leaflet for children to fill in on the way round and a range of merchandise. Visitors who completed the leaflet were given the Pikachu with Grey Felt Hat promo card, and Pokémon Center online gave the card with every item of its Pokémon Center × Van Gogh Museum collection, which sold out at once. After scenes of people collecting the free card to resell it, the museum stopped giving it out after 13 October 2023, citing safety and security. In February 2024 shops in the Netherlands gave the card away with purchases of Pokémon cards.
